name: Subset Teaching Dimension / Recursive Teaching Dimension (Incomparable)
details: Neither parameter admits a universal upper bound in terms of the other, even up to an affine-linear factor.
parameter_1_larger_witness: For every $u\ge2$, the family $\mathcal C^u_{1/2}=\{\{x_i\}:i\in[u+1]\}\cup\{\{x_i,x_j\}:i,j\in[u+1]\}$ has $\mathrm{STD}=u$ and $\mathrm{RTD}=2$.
parameter_2_larger_witness: For every $u$, the paired family $\mathcal C^u_{\mathrm{pair}}$ of Theorem 35 has $\mathrm{STD}=1$ and $\mathrm{RTD}=u$.
proof: Theorem 36 proves the first directional separation, and Theorem 35 proves the second. Both families are explicitly constructed in the cited paper.
